frontend.mechanism: Actual transpiled callbacks and JSX with explicit transport, state, React static-rendering and portal doubles.

api.backend: Disposable SQLite and FastAPI TestClient, no application listener or worker.
passing_controls: Two deliberate distinct keys create two distinct jobs
Same-key queued, processing, cancelling and committed return original task
failing_checks: Same-key failed job creates another task
Same-key cancelled job creates another task
Changed order returns 202 instead of conflict
Changed title returns 202 instead of conflict
Changed project returns 202 instead of conflict
Archived source hides existing receipt behind 400 validation
Proposed read-only admission lookup is absent, returning 404

limits.real_network_response_loss: NOT_VERIFIED; simulated transport failure is explicit
